notes.title: Burning Skies Arcade - Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/7243354/040b707d40275c5971df644db46612103b8b95ef.gif[/img]

Hello folks, based on your feedback I've worked for the last weeks, on an update for the Burning Skies Arcade Demo, here's what changed:

[h2]Improvements/Fetures[/h2]
[list][*] Highscore
[*] Saving the settings and Hiscore
[*] A little tutorial at the beggining of the demo
[*] Feedback when the player picks a power up
[*] Ajusted audio mastering[/list]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][*] New Range Power Up[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list][*] Adjusted the space between projectiles on one of the boss's attacks[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
- Wall creation with missing parts
- Audio didn't set to zero
- Glitch when music interlapping
- glitch engine sfx interlapping
- when pausing at the beggining the menu whould not show up
 
Check the free demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290190/Burning_Skies_Arcade/

As aways, thanks for your support, and please join our discord and tell me what do you think of this new update. 

[url=https://discord.nukgames.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802060/ac01faddf114bfe95350f607d1767587e9d027bb.gif[/img][/url]


Burning Skies Arcade is a freeware version of Burning Skies, a bigger roguelite shmup that we'll release next year, please wishlist it so you'll receive updates when we have any news

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

notes.title: Razortron 2000 - Massive Update!
Cyberhunt MASSIVE UPDATE.
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/70a6c68e45527e58b17eb9882f1193eaf1382f53.gif[/img]
Hello friends, I have been silent for the past few months, and the reason for that is that I was making a huge update to CYBERHUNT, I basically remade it from the ground up. 
[list][*] Changed the game engine
[*] All graphics remade
[*] New missions system
[*] Enemies IA remade and added 2 new enemies (tank and missile)
[*] Controls improved and modernized
[*] New SFX
[*] and A LOT MORE... [/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/cc897322bf3be83f5a06389364af52f19618cf1c.gif[/img]
In case you prefer, you can also access the original version of CYBERHUNT by selecting the option when launching the game. 

I choose to release this as a update and not as a sequel to thank you all for all the support and give some back to the communty that gave me so much!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/15171fc99f2047ac411bb1ad47fa1b13a46ea3c8.gif[/img]
Please let me know if you enjoyed this update, it took a lot of time and work to make it, maybe I'll do something like this with another of my titles if I feel that you guys liked.

My newest game is on sale right now, for the lowest price EVER, please check it out. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/
As aways thank you very much for all the support.
Paulo

notes.title: Polygoneer FREE + Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/980fae71b7c0d1964e524831fdb157ad091ab4c9.gif[/img]

Hello friends, with giveaway of [b]POLYGONEER[/b] the playerbase of the game has grown exponentially and some of the new players reported dificulties to play the game with different keyboard layouts. So I updated the game following this requests:

- Support to QWERTY, QWERTZ and AZERTY layouts (just acces the config on the options menu)
- 10 Options to change the sensitivity that the turret rotates (default is 5) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/a805c1949ae29753010a97cc2879a97f3b44f008.jpg[/img]

The game can still be downloaded for [b]free[/b] for the next two weeks so let your friends know

https://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/

I'm also working on a new and bigger game, It would be great if you guys could check it out and add to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052650/Razortron_2084/

notes.notes:

Hello friends, I'm happy with all the feedback on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/]Polygoneer[/url][/b] and glad it reached the status of very positive.

notes.title: Update #1 - 50% off
notes.notes:
Hello friends, I hope everyone is fine! 

On first update for Razortron 2000 the biggest change is the difficult to unlock the cars and consequently to get the achievements that has lowered considerably. 
I also fixed some bugs based on your feedback, here's the list:

[list] [*]bug when changing the game to windowed let the screen very small;
[*] The music from the menu doesn't turn down with the rest of the game;
[*] The SFX from car selection screen was to loud;[/list]

I hope you guys enjoy the game, and if you like it please post a review, that helps A LOT for smaller games like this one.

Thank you very much for the incredible support, you guys are amazing!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26504646/aae5eafda9cb6e476106571be5815f37f3f102cc.jpg[/img]
